known_limitations: Twenty-two closed OHLC observations determine rolling highest high/lowest low. True range uses high-low and differences from previous close; the first row uses high-low. ATR22 seeds the first22 true ranges with their mean then applies Wilder recursion. Strictly positive ATR is required.

Long level=rollingHH22-3*ATR22; short level=rollingLL22+3*ATR22. BUY-held close below long level or SELL-held close above short level requests exit. Equality waits; missing observations cannot request it. The level is not ratcheted; this is not the existing prior-close ATR trail.
The source gives daily22/3 defaults. Applying these periods to M5, close-confirmed timing and trend_up/London/normal scope are explicit lab adaptations, not validated publisher results.

Only phase=exit on an already owned position evaluates this operator. Existing native gap-stop/target precedence, sizing, costs and account ledger remain unchanged. Current scope does not claim regime-wide or session-wide position coverage.
